The job failed at 'Exercise the selected Chrome side-panel case'; no side panel was reached. verdict_a_behavior.interpretation: This is a failed acceptance attempt caused by setup failure, not evidence of a product behavior failure or pass. No product case verdict can be inferred.

verdict_b_evidence_quality.resource_attribution: Guest journal first admitted the run (12.6 GiB available, load 1.17, CPU busy 0.0129), then recorded RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING at 98% busy and one-minute load 11.58 on four logical CPUs. Its process snapshot shows Chromium at 84.8%, Chromium helpers at 40.1%, 17%, 15.2%, plus system processes including duetexpertd at 28.4%, lsd at 17.8% and 16.8%, usernoted at 13.5%, and mds at 13.3%. Chromium was a material contributor in this snapshot, but the snapshot is aggregate/instantaneous and includes unrelated system load. It does not prove CPU pressure caused the earlier owned_cdp_endpoint_timeout.
verdict_b_evidence_quality.hash_method: SHA-256 recomputed over the extracted nested receipt and all three extracted current-run journals. Driver and workflow hashes recomputed from the run's exact head commit. Live GitHub run/job metadata and artifact ID/name/digest were queried read-only; artifact digest matches the recorded downloaded ZIP digest.
